text.p: The spot BFI (Baltic Freight Index) rose 13 points to 1,281, although brokers reported slightly easier conditions for Panamaxes for early positions in the U.S. Gulf.
However, strong rates are still being paid, basis loading second-half November.

Transfield fixed Brazilian Venture 70,728 tonnes dwt delivery Rotterdam mid-November for a trip via U.S. Gulf redelivery Far East at $13,250 daily, up $250 daily from the same charterer's fixture of Giovanni Bottiglieri 75,265 tonnes dwt.
Japanese charterers were active in the Far East where conditions for Panamaxes continue to strengthen, they said.
A number of modern vessels have been fixed in this area for short periods, such as three to five months at between $10,000 and $10,500 daily. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8080
